entities.summary: Howard Eric Jacobson is a British novelist and journalist. He writes comic novels that often revolve around the dilemmas of British Jewish characters. He is a Man Booker Prize winner. Howard Jacobson was a journalists & chroniclers from Manchester (b. 1942-08-25, Manchester). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
